payload.claim: Several parenthetical line-number citations under the Context section pointing into saffron/task.py (task.py:652, :657-658, :664, :668) are off by several lines against this snapshot, e.g. task.py:657-658 now lands on 'row = ledger.spec_text(task_id)' / 'if row is None:' rather than on the '_refused' helper or the parse-error line the prose is illustrating. This is explained by the spec's own disclaimer ('Every line number below was read at 65f65032') combined with the fact that SA-0372 touched saffron/task.py between 65f65032 and this spec's base 67c984b1; saffron/regate.py, saffron/follow_up.py, and tests/test_regate.py were not touched in that window, so every citation into those files (including the ones in the Problem section that the cell actually must act on, e.g. regate.py:55-58, regate.py:155, tests/test_regate.py:943) remains exact. The substantive sentences the drifted citations support are still true in substance; only the parenthetical pointer is stale, and saffron/task.py is itself out of scope and forbidden, so nothing the cell builds depends on these numbers.
